question: What kinds of prepared food are presented as suitable and delightful offerings?
premises: Food made from barley and wheat is mentioned.
Food cooked in ghee is mentioned as an alternative.
Such food is described as delightful.
inference: Delightful offerings include items made from barley and wheat or cooked in ghee.
plain_english: Or also that which is made from barley and wheat, cooked in ghee and delightful.
